messages:
Maria Nguyen: Heads-up — AcmeCorp private deploy scheduled next Tue. They want VPC-only, strict egress controls, customer-managed KMS, and 13mo immutable audit retention. Can we sketch RBAC + audit + network policy guarantees for on‑prem?

Kevin Patel: For egress we should front with an egress proxy that enforces allowlist + TLS inspection to our collector. No direct outbound from pods. Admin access via jumpbox only (bastion host with MFA).

Sanjay Rao: KMS integration: we support envelope encryption with customer keys (AWS KMS / Azure KeyVault / on-prem HSM). Typical flow is: node/proxy has a short-lived client cert from Vault, Vault mints an envelope key using customer CMK, we store encrypted blobs. Example (AWS CLI pseudo):

```
# customer side: create key and grant Redwood role
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/acme-logs --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-logs --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
\n# redwood side: request data key, encrypt logs
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/acme-logs --key-spec AES_256 > plaintext+cipher
```

Sanjay Rao: For on-prem HSM we recommend PKCS#11 and tie Vault to the HSM for auto-rotation. Ensure we never persist plaintext keys on disk.

Elaine Kim: RBAC proposal: per-tenant k8s namespaces, network policies to prevent cross-namespace egress except to approved proxies, and RBAC roles scoped to groups (acme-admins). Use short-lived OIDC tokens (1h) issued by customer IdP or our control plane; no long-lived service account tokens. All RBAC changes must go through PR + signed audit annotation.

Maria Nguyen: Audit logging: customer wants 13 months append-only. We can stream audit events to a customer S3 (or on-prem object store) encrypted with their key, and also forward a copy to SIEM via syslog/splunk forwarder. Need retention policy and WORM mode if they require immutability.

Kevin Patel: Network policy details: use Calico with GlobalNetworkPolicy to enforce egress deny-by-default and explicit allow to: NTP, customer's telemetry collector, and the egress-proxy. Use hostEndpoints for jumpbox/pools. Document node pool labels to isolate tenants to node pools when required.

security-bot: IMAGE_SCAN: quay.io/lib/oldlib:1.2.3 -> HIGH CVE-2020-12345. Found in debug sidecar for legacy telemetry.

Elaine Kim: Triage for the vuln: isolate nodepool running that image, remove sidecar from new deploys, schedule rebuilds. Also rotate any KMS grants that were scoped to the old role as a precaution and revoke instance profile access.

Sanjay Rao: Agreed. Action items: 1) Run `kubectl cordon` + drain affected nodes, 2) revoke & rotate KMS grants for role `redwood-telemetry`, 3) push updated images with patched lib.

Kevin Patel: I'll draft the runbook sections: egress design, jumpbox flows, Calico policy examples, and KMS grant patterns. Elaine — can you add the RBAC PR template + audit annotation snippet?

Elaine Kim: Yep. I'll include a sample audit annotation: `redwood.audit: {"pr":123, "approver":"sec-lead"}` and a policy that requires signed commits for RBAC YAMLs.

Maria Nguyen: Great. Please target a short runbook + checklist by EOD Friday. Also flag any blocker (HSM connector, SIEM endpoints, legal for 13mo retention).

security-bot: REMINDER: schedule key rotation alerts 30 days before expiry for customer CMKs.
